basics.name: Victor Svizev
basics.label: Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer
basics.summary: Certified senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer with 9+ years of experience in distributed teams. Specialize in commercial extension development, platform upgrades, and compatibility management. Hands-on experience with Hyvä Theme and Adobe App Builder. Integrate AI into development workflows. Independently design, build, and sell Magento extensions on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace.

work.name: TechDivision GmbH
work.summary: Maintain and enhance a portfolio of 140+ Magento extensions, including Symfony-based components.
highlights: Write technical specifications and development tickets; maintain technical and end-user documentation.
Develop new modules and features, refactor code, and resolve issues.
Expand test coverage for new features and modules, including regression and edge-case tests.
Maintain compatibility with supported PHP versions and ensure day-one compatibility of extensions with new Magento releases by supporting them from beta versions onward.
Conduct code reviews to uphold quality and reliability standards.
Manage package dependencies, versioning and release pipelines.
Support internal teams on development topics and customers on first-line issue resolution.
Own the technical implementation of major Adobe Commerce upgrades in client projects.
Develop compatibility modules for Hyvä Theme and Hyvä Checkout.
Develop applications on Adobe App Builder.
Develop Claude Code and OpenCode plugins to integrate AI into company-wide development workflows.

work.name: netz98 GmbH – a valantic company
highlights: Contributed to three B2B and B2C client projects in two teams.
Developed new features and customized third-party extensions.
Integrated third-party services and resolved issues.
Expanded test coverage for new features and conducted code reviews.

work.name: UNlimited world trade union GmbH
highlights: Owned end-to-end development (frontend, backend and test environments) of the company's four Magento B2B and B2C stores in a two-person team.
Maintained and modernized legacy customizations and improved production stability.
Migrated stores from Magento 1.7 to 1.9 and from 1.9 to 2.3, replacing or rewriting extensions and themes for the new versions.
Contributed to the development of a custom catalog import.
Implemented regulatory requirements in the stores.
